text:
Emma Morse: hey everyone! i'm emma, starting today as a developer advocate. pronouns she/her. i'm mostly remote from portland but planning a week in the SF office in two weeks. i'm into tiny library exchanges, sourdough experiments, and battling my ficus for desk real estate. excited to meet you all! :wave:
Kai: welcome emma!! tiny library exchange?? tell me more, i have a stack of sci-fi novellas that need loving homes. also we have a 'leave-behind' shelf by the kitchen.
Ralph: hi emma, welcome! if you're in SF two weeks from now there's usually a rooftop meetup Thursday evening. perfect for book swaps and sourdough sampling. :bread: :books:
Ben (IT): Emma 5 badge/email set up. You should receive the badge pickup email in a sec. If you want a wired ethernet dongle shipped before your SF week, DM me your address.
Emma Morse: thanks Ben! i'll take the dongle please, shipping to Portland is fine.
Sage: welcome !! i'm the snack steward this week 5 we have dark chocolate and rosemary crackers. also pro tip: bring a labeled jar if you want to stash starter for the office sourdough group.
Emma Morse: Ooo rosemary crackers sound like an underappreciated hero. i will absolutely label my jar. also anyone down for a "tiny library" channel? we can post one-line blurbs and drop books when in-office.
Kai: add me. i'll post my badly-written blurbs. :grimacing: also emma, do you have a fav sci-fi rec?
Emma Morse: my top rec is The Long Way to a Small Angry Planet 5 it's cozy and great for train/plane reads.
Ralph: great pick. also FYI there's a desk-plant adoption table on the 3rd floor this Friday at lunch if you want a ficus sidekick. :seedling:
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: welcome_message_sent to Emma Morse; badge_assigned.
Emma Morse: excited to join the tiny-library + plant gang. see you folks in two weeks for the rooftop swap! :sparkles:
